Action.CheckUpdatesTip: apt update, then the list of packages to upgrade
Action.OpenSshTip: Open a terminal on this server
AppUpdate.AutoCheckDesc: At startup, then every 12 h, from the project's GitHub Releases. The new version is downloaded in the background.
AppUpdate.AutoInstallDesc: A downloaded version is installed when the app closes (or at the next startup). Otherwise, use "Restart and update".
AppUpdate.PrereleaseDesc: Also receive beta versions, to try new features early (less stable).
AppUpdate.ReadyAuto: Version {0} downloaded: it will be installed when the application closes.
AppUpdate.ReadyManual: Open the settings to restart and install it.
AppUpdate.ReadyNoAuto: Version {0} downloaded, ready to be installed.
AppUpdate.ReadyOnExit: It will be installed when the application closes. Click to restart now from the settings.
AppUpdate.SidebarTip: Vibe SSH Monitoring {0} is ready: restart to install it
AppUpdate.Unavailable: Automatic updates unavailable: this copy was not installed with the installer (development build).
AppUpdate.UpToDate: You have the latest version · checked {0}
BulkReboot.ConfirmText: Each server will be unavailable for a few moments.
BulkUpgrade.ConfirmText: apt-get update then upgrade on each server, four at a time. Follow the progress on the cards, and the details in each server's log.
Card.RebootTip: The server asks for a reboot: the /var/run/reboot-required file exists. Some installed updates (usually the kernel, the C library or systemd) only take effect after a reboot.
Delete.ConfirmText: The server and its saved credentials will be removed from the application. Nothing is changed on the server.
Detail.NoApt: apt-get was not found: this server is not Debian / Ubuntu.
Detail.NoPackages: No pending updates. "Check updates" refreshes the list from the repositories.
Detail.PackagesUnknown: List unknown for now: "Check updates" queries the repositories.
Editor.DeployExisting: Your key {0}.pub will be added to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of {1} on {2}. The key login is then checked, and the server switches to key authentication. The password stays saved for sudo.
Editor.DeployNew: A new ed25519 key ({0}) will be created, then its public part will be added to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of {1} on {2}. The key login is then checked, and the server switches to key authentication. The password stays saved for sudo.
Editor.ForgetKeyTip: The next connection will ask again to approve the server's key
Editor.HintNone: Without elevation, "Check updates", "Update" and reboots will fail for lack of root rights.
Editor.HintRoot: Direct root login: no elevation needed.
Editor.HintSu: Root commands go through su, with the root password (servers that refuse direct root logins).
Editor.HintSudo: Root commands go through sudo (the user's password, or a NOPASSWD rule).
Editor.InvalidHost: Enter the server's IP address or hostname.
Editor.InvalidPort: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
Editor.OverridesDesc: "Global" follows the application settings; any other choice takes precedence for this server.
Editor.PasswordMissing: Enter the password (or choose an SSH key).
Editor.Subtitle: Debian or Ubuntu server reachable over SSH. Passwords are stored in the vault, never in the configuration.
Editor.SudoSameDesc: Turn off if sudo asks for another password, or leave it empty for a NOPASSWD rule.
Editor.TipText: an SSH key is safer than a password and lets you open external terminals without typing anything. This button creates your key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519) if needed, installs it on the server and switches the connection to it.
Empty.NoMatchText: Change the search or the selected group.
Empty.NoServersText: Add a VPS or a dedicated server (Debian / Ubuntu): address, user, and password or SSH key.
Error.AptUpdateFailed: apt-get update failed (code {0}). See the log.
Error.UpgradeFailed: The update failed (code {0}). See the log.
Exit.ConfirmTerminals: {0} terminal session(s) are open and will be closed.
HostKey.ChangedText: The key presented by {0} ({1}) does not match the saved one. This is normal after the server was reinstalled; otherwise it may be an interception (man-in-the-middle). Only accept if you know why it changed.
HostKey.NewText: First connection to {0} ({1}). Check that the fingerprint matches the server's (ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub), then approve it.
Notify.HostKeyChangedText: The key of {0} has changed. Connection refused for safety: check the server.
Password.Label: Password
Password.Mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Reboot.ConfirmText: The server will be unavailable for a few moments. Sessions open on it will be cut.
Restart.ConfirmTerminals: The application will restart: the {0} open terminal session(s) will be closed.
Settings.AboutDesc: Version {0} · monitoring of Debian / Ubuntu servers over SSH · GPL-3.0 license
Settings.AutoCheckDesc: Runs "Check updates" (apt update, as root) in the background at this interval.
Settings.AutoLockDesc: Forgets the passwords after a period of inactivity. Servers that need them switch to "Vault locked".
Settings.AutoRemoveDesc: apt-get autoremove --purge: removes dependencies that are no longer needed (old kernels…).
Settings.CloseToTrayDesc: The ✕ button hides the window instead of exiting. To exit, use the icon's menu.
Settings.ConciseDesc: Uses shorter texts for the buttons that this language makes long. The change applies after a restart.
Settings.CopyPassword: Copy the password for external terminals
Settings.CopyPasswordDesc: ssh.exe cannot receive the password: it is put in the clipboard (outside the Win+V history) and cleared after 30 s.
Settings.LanguageDesc: Interface language. "System" follows the Windows display language. The change applies after a restart.
Settings.MasterPasswordDesc: Changes the password that encrypts the vault.
Settings.NotifyOffline: Notify when a server stops responding
Settings.OpenDetailsOnUpgrade: Open the server page when updating
Settings.OpenDetailsOnUpgradeDesc: "Update" shows the server's details to follow the log live. Off: you stay on the current page and follow the progress on the card.
Settings.RootShell: Open the terminal directly as root
Settings.RootShellDesc: Runs sudo -i or su - when opening (built-in terminal: the password is typed for you).
Settings.ShortcutsDesc: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+3: switch page   ·   Ctrl+N: add a server   ·   F5: refresh all   ·   Terminal: Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V, right click = copy/paste
Settings.ShowOnlineDesc: SSH port test before each reading.
Settings.ShowResourcesDesc: CPU, memory and disk (/) usage, system load.
Settings.ShowUpdatesDesc: Number of packages to upgrade (including security) and "reboot required".
Settings.StartMinimizedDesc: Opens directly in the notification area; monitoring runs in the background.
Settings.StorageDpapiDesc: Encrypted by Windows and tied to your session: nothing to type, unreadable from another account or another PC.
Settings.StorageMasterDesc: Encrypted with your master password (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM), asked at startup.
Settings.StoragePlainDesc: ⚠ Readable by anyone or any program with access to your %⁠APPDATA⁠% folder.
Settings.Subtitle: Global settings. Each server can override the monitoring, terminal and update settings in its own settings.
Settings.TerminalDesc: Built-in: tabs in the app, password typed automatically. External: the Windows OpenSSH client.
Settings.UpgradeKindDesc: upgrade never removes packages and keeps "held back" packages (often the kernel). full-upgrade installs them, removing packages if needed.
Ssh.AuthFailed: Authentication refused: check the user, password or key.
Ssh.ConnectionRefused: Connection refused: is the SSH port closed?
Ssh.HostKeyChanged: WARNING: the server's host key has changed. Connection refused.
Ssh.HostKeyUnknown: Unknown host key: it must be approved before the first connection.
Ssh.HostNotFound: Host not found (wrong name or address).
Ssh.KeyNeedsPassphrase: This key is protected by a passphrase: enter it in the server settings.
Ssh.KeyUnreadable: Unreadable private key or wrong passphrase: {0}
Ssh.NoPassword: No password saved for this server.
Ssh.NoRootPassword: Root password not set (required for su).
Ssh.NotRoot: Insufficient rights: set up root access (sudo or su) in the server settings.
Ssh.SuNoPrompt: su did not ask for a password: {0}
Ssh.SuNoPromptTimeout: su did not ask for a password (timed out).
Ssh.SudoMissing: sudo is not installed on this server: use su.
Ssh.SudoNeedsPassword: sudo asks for a password: enter it in the server settings.
Ssh.SudoNotAllowed: This user is not allowed to use sudo.
Ssh.Timeout: Timed out: the server is not responding.
Ssh.VaultLockedConnect: Vault locked: unlock it to connect.
Ssh.VaultLockedPassphrase: Vault locked: the key passphrase is not available.
Ssh.VaultLockedRoot: Vault locked: the root password is not available.
Ssh.VaultLockedSudo: Vault locked: the sudo password is not available.
Terminal.CustomCommandEmpty: The custom terminal command is empty.
Terminal.EmbeddedNotExternal: The built-in terminal does not open in an external window.
Terminal.PuttyNotFound: PuTTY was not found (neither in Program Files nor in the PATH).
TerminalView.Cancelled: Connection cancelled. Press Enter to try again.
TerminalView.Ended: Session ended. Press Enter to reconnect.
TerminalView.NoWebView2: The Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime was not found. Install it, or choose an external terminal in the settings.
Terminals.AddServerFirst: First add a server on the Servers page.
Terminals.EmptyText: Use "Open SSH" on a server, or open one here.
Terminals.NewTip: Open a terminal on a server
Test.KeyInstalled: Key installed and checked: the connection now uses {0}.
Test.NoElevation: No elevation configured: apt and reboots will fail without root rights.
Toast.PasswordCopied: Password copied to the clipboard (cleared in 30 s): paste it with a right click.
Updates.NeverChecked: No update check from the app yet
Upgrade.ConfirmText: apt-get update then apt-get {0}, without interaction (locally modified configuration files are kept). {1}
Upgrade.ListRefreshed: The package list will be refreshed just before.
Vault.CreateText: This password encrypts your servers' credentials. It cannot be recovered: write it down somewhere safe.
Vault.LockedNotifyText: Click here to open the application and enter the master password.
Vault.NewText: The vault will be encrypted again with this password.
Vault.PlainText: Anyone or any program with access to your session will be able to read them in secrets.json. The Windows (DPAPI) mode is just as seamless, without this risk.
Vault.SetText: It will encrypt your servers' credentials and be asked at every startup. It cannot be recovered: write it down somewhere safe.
Vault.TipMaster: Passwords encrypted with the master password (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM)
Vault.TipPlain: Passwords stored in plain text in the secrets.json file
Vault.TipWindows: Passwords encrypted by Windows (DPAPI), tied to your session
Vault.UnlockBeforeModeChange: Unlock the vault before changing the storage mode.
Vault.UnlockText: Enter the master password to access your servers' credentials.
